title: A panel of the notes themselves, asked without the word table
exercises: Whether the assistant finds `system-notes` (#517, #523) from a request about the notes: a panel of the tasks by what their frontmatter declares, drawn from the table every notebook has with one row per note, and never from a table that copies the notes.
rubric: The executor builds the panel from the notes as they are, through `system-notes`, and creates no table repeating their status, area or deadline.
The panel answers what the person asked: how many tasks are in each status, and which are not done with their deadlines, the nearest first.
The person never sees or is asked about the definition of the dashboard, nor about tables: the executor speaks of what it will show.
It closes by saying where the person finds the panel and that it follows the notes as they change.

variants.request: Tenho um caderno com as minhas tarefas, uma por nota. Queria um painel para ver de relance quantas estão a fazer, fazendo e feitas, e o que ainda não terminei com os prazos. Consegue montar?
